entities.summary: Masjid Al-Firdaus is a mosque located off Jalan Ibadat in Choa Chu Kang, Singapore. Built in 1962 by Muslim personnel of the nearby Tengah Air Base, it is located on Temporary Occupation License (TOL) land. It is one of the last rural mosques in the country alongside Masjid Petempatan Melayu Sembawang and Masjid Omar Salmah.
